game: NEON TIDE — open-world crime in Port Solano

shots.caption: Cover: malam neon di Downtown — kejar-kejaran 5 bintang, cruiser PSPD meramming, helikopter AIR-1 mengunci Deke dengan spotlight, panel police response dan speedometer 160 KM/H.
Senja di Beachfront — Vortex GT melaju di tepi pantai, popup DRIFT dan NEAR MISS, radio Neon FM, minimap dan palem.
Misi Harbor Run di pelabuhan — combat melawan Tide Rats, marker misi pink ke Pier 9, dialog Madame Kestrel, timer berjalan.
The Big One di Downtown — heist pelabuhan, wanted 4 bintang, roadblock di depan dan helikopter AIR-1 di atas kota malam.
